item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q07","reason":"Aggregate pickups by location before the left join, preserving duplicate zone matches and unmatched NULL borough groups. Cast the final sum to BIGINT to match COUNT(*).","sql":"WITH pickups AS (SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID) SELECT z.Borough AS borough, CAST(SUM(p.n) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM pickups p LEFT JOIN zones z ON p.PULocationID = z.LocationID GROUP BY z.Borough"},{"query_id":"q08","reason":"Derive daily counts using a partitioned window and DISTINCT, then retain the original AVG window, DATE values, NULL group, and observed-day frame.","sql":"WITH daily AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(tpep_pickup_datetime AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(tpep_pickup_datetime AS DATE)) AS trips FROM trips) SELECT day, AVG(trips) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling FROM daily"}]}
